en: Changed an in-process teammate's `agent_id` in Agent results to its agent ID (its `name@team` address stays in `teammate_id`); TeammateIdle hooks no longer fire from its subagents or forks
zh: 变更 Agent 结果中进程内队友的 `agent_id` 为其 agent ID（其 `name@team` 地址保留在 `teammate_id` 中）；TeammateIdle hooks 不再由其 subagents 或 fork 触发
